simpleearth.screen.title: Simple Earth
simpleearth.screen.reset.tip: Sets every value of this version and the display settings back to their defaults
simpleearth.screen.dev_button.tip: Simple Earth: version and settings (dev button)
simpleearth.version.1.name: V1 Tile cube
simpleearth.version.1.desc: Fixed tiles, the cube turns by the shortest rotation; over a corner it flips about the diagonal.
simpleearth.version.2.name: V2 Cone fold
simpleearth.version.2.desc: Like V1, but around each corner the fourth tile is squeezed in as a wedge.
simpleearth.version.3.name: V3 Corner window
simpleearth.version.3.desc: Like V1; near a corner a small window shows the diagonal tile, crossing it turns the cube inside out like a tesseract.
simpleearth.version.4.name: V4 Rolling cube
simpleearth.version.4.desc: The cube rolls on under you without jerks; side faces blend the old and new neighbour.
simpleearth.version.5.name: V5 Smooth ball
simpleearth.version.5.desc: A rounder body whose ground under you always stays level.
simpleearth.version.6.name: V6 Folding net
simpleearth.version.6.desc: Standard. Nothing turns: the tile under you stays flat and the neighbours fold in from the edge.
simpleearth.version.7.name: V7 Cell net
simpleearth.version.7.desc: The folding net made of flat cube cells - the unfolding net of a four-dimensional cube.
simpleearth.version.8.name: V8 Net and inversion
simpleearth.version.8.desc: The folding net; corner windows fill the gaps and the corner of the world turns inside out.
simpleearth.version.9.name: V9 Folding shell
simpleearth.version.9.desc: All 25 tiles stay joined: the corner tiles open like windows, nothing ever fades.
simpleearth.version.10.name: V10 Tipping cube
simpleearth.version.10.desc: A sharp cube, its top always level under you. At an edge it tips over like a rolled die; bright edge lines.
simpleearth.version.11.name: V11 Puzzle cube
simpleearth.version.11.desc: Tips like V10; every face is split into pieces with joints over a dark core - a cube built from cubes.
simpleearth.version.12.name: V12 Corner view
simpleearth.version.12.desc: Tips like V10; the higher you fly, the more a corner turns up to you until three faces show like a block icon.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.title: Simple Earth
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.activ: From this height on your position is tracked for the orbit; where you cross it becomes the centre of your earth. The server may raise it. Default: 1024.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.switc: From this height on the world below is shown as the earth. Below it everything is Vanilla. Default: 1536.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.ceili: At this height the earth is furthest away (orbit distance). Default: 6144.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.fadeB: Blocks above the render switch over which the earth fades in. Default: 128.
Blocks per earth face; behind every edge lies new terrain. Default: 65536.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.orbit: Blocks per second you glide over the earth with the movement keys (capped by the server). Default: 256.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.faceR: Pixels per face close to the earth at detail level 2 (the display detail level doubles or halves it per step; fewer further away). Default: 256.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.orbit: How far away the earth is at the ceiling height, in cube widths. Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.relie: Map shading by height like a Vanilla map (1 = Vanilla). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.atmos: Strength of the stepped atmosphere rim. Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.moonS: Size of the cube moon (0 = no moon). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.stars: Brightness of the stars in orbit. Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.round: How round the edges and corners are (3-step stair like the UI frames). Default: 0.07 (V10: 0.02).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: Seconds of the turn over the corner of the world. Default: 0.35.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldR: How far around each corner the plane is folded (share of half a face). Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.inver: Seconds of the tesseract inversion at a corner. Default: 0.9.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.windo: From which distance to the corner the corner window opens (0 = middle, 1 = corner). Default: 0.5.
Largest size of the corner window. Default: 0.62.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.follo: How quickly the shown cube follows its true position (higher = stiffer). Default: 6 (V5: 10).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.north: How quickly north turns back to the top of the screen. Default: 2.5.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.expon: Shape of the smooth body: low = ball, high = cube. Default: 8.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.foldS: From which point of the face the neighbour starts to fold in (0 = middle). Default: 0.1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.cellD: Depth of the cube cells. Default: 0.18.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.lineA: Visibility of the hinge and tesseract lines. Default: 0.6 (V9: 0.35).
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.enabl: Server: turns Simple Earth on or off. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.dimen: Server: dimensions with an orbit. Default: the Overworld.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.minAc: Server: clients cannot pick a lower activation height (never below build height + 64). Default: 1024.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.minSw: Server: the render switch lies at least this far above the activation height. Default: 128.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.maxOr: Server: highest glide speed in blocks per second (the client speeds up with the height; parked players load no chunks). Default: 32768.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.explo: Server: shows terrain only where the world already has region files, so the earth gives away no seed map. Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.showO: E9: other players in orbit appear as dots (players on the ground never). A server option and a display option; both must be on. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.speed: The orbit speed applies at the render switch; higher up it grows with your height so the earth passes equally fast (up to the server limit). Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.worke: Server: background threads that read terrain from the world generator. Default: half the CPU cores, 2 to 4.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tiles: Server: terrain tiles each player gets per second. Default: 24.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.memor: Server: terrain tiles kept in memory. Default: 1024.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.diskC: Server: size of the tile cache in the world folder, oldest deleted first (0 = none). Default: 256.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.slowF: Server: seconds of slow falling after dropping back into the world. Default: 30.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.detai: How fine the faces near you are: 1 coarse ... 5 very fine (each step twice as fine; 2 = the tile under you as before 25.10.). Higher costs loading time and frame time. Default: 3.
How many tile rings around yours keep the full detail level; every ring further is half as fine. Default: 0.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.rende: How far the earth is drawn, in tile rings around yours: 1 = only the neighbours, 2 = everything (far ring and the cube bottom). Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.paint: Thousand pixels of face images painted per frame. Lower keeps the frame rate steady, higher sharpens faster. Default: 192.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.textu: How many painted face images stay in memory. Default: 64.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tileC: How many terrain tiles from the server the client keeps (about 12 KB each). Default: 2048.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.faceE: How dark the 1-pixel border of every tile is (0 = none). Default: 0.28.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.moonP: E10: the cube moon follows Vanilla's moon phase; off = always full moon. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tipTi: Seconds the cube takes to tip over an edge. Default: 0.6.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.edgeL: How bright the twelve cube edges are drawn (0 = none). Default: 0.8.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.cells: Each face is split into this many x this many pieces. Default: 3.
Gap between the pieces (share of the face). Default: 0.05.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.corne: How far the corner turns up to you at the top (1 = three faces equally, 0 = never). Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.tiltS: Share of the way from the render switch to the ceiling height where the corner starts to turn. Default: 0.35.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.minGr: Server: finest sample spacing served, 2^value blocks (5 = 32). Caps what high client detail levels cost. Default: 5.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.biome: Server: from 128 blocks per pixel the biome is asked at value x value points and the majority wins (1 = one point; 3 = smoother, slower). Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.surfa: Server: what the generator puts on top - snow where Vanilla's height temperature lets it snow, frozen water, stone on steep slopes, badlands red sand and bands. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.globa: Server, E4: off = the cube centre is where you cross the activation height; on = the nearest point of a world-wide grid (all players share faces). Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.requi: Server, E5: off = any way up counts; on = the orbit only starts while flying (creative flight or elytra). Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.reent: Server, E6/N3: on = dropping back or logging out puts you at the orbit position; off = back to the park point. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simpleearth.option.fastH: Server: ground height from the generator's preliminary surface level, like Chunkbase (many times faster); off = the exact noise column per sample (slow). Default: on.
simpleearth.guide.page.1.title: Simple Earth
simpleearth.guide.page.1: Fly very high and the Overworld turns into a cube in orbit, its faces painted in map colours straight from the world generator. Below everything stays Vanilla. Open this guide again with /simpleearth guide.
simpleearth.guide.page.2.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.2: Below the activation height (default 1024, never below build height + 64) everything is Vanilla. Crossing it marks your centre A. Above the render switch height (default 1536, at least 128 higher) you are parked:
simpleearth.guide.page.3.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.3: the figure stays over the park point, the movement keys glide your orbit position at the orbit speed (default 256 blocks per second at the switch height,
simpleearth.guide.page.4.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.4: faster the higher you are; server cap 32768), up and down stay Vanilla.
simpleearth.guide.page.5.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.5: Dropping 16 blocks below the switch puts you back into the world at the orbit position with 30 seconds of slow falling (unless flying); 16 blocks below the activation height the orbit ends. Only the Overworld by default;
simpleearth.guide.page.6.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.6: players without the mod never enter it. Server options:
simpleearth.guide.page.7.title: Orbit
simpleearth.guide.page.7: globalGrid (E4, the centre snaps to a world-wide grid so all players share faces), requireFlight (E5, only while flying), reentryAtOrbit (E6, off = back to the park point, also on logout).
simpleearth.guide.page.8.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.8: The faces show Vanilla map colours (grass, leaves, sand, snow, water, terracotta ...) with map-style height shading. Each pixel is one sample read from the world generator: the ground height (standard:
simpleearth.guide.page.9.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.9: the generator's preliminary surface, one density function per column - fastHeights) and the noise biome there, like Chunkbase - no chunk is loaded or generated.
simpleearth.guide.page.10.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.10: Samples sit on a global grid (64 x 64 per tile), are sampled by background threads (default half the CPU cores, 2 to 4), cached in memory and in the world folder (default 256 MiB, oldest deleted first) and sent at up
simpleearth.guide.page.11.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.11: to 24 tiles per second per player. Faces start coarse and sharpen. Surface detail (server option surfaceDetail, on):
simpleearth.guide.page.12.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.12: snow where Vanilla's height-adjusted biome temperature lets it snow, frozen water in cold biomes, stone or packed ice on steep slopes, red sand and terracotta bands in the badlands - all from heights and biomes, still without
simpleearth.guide.page.13.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.13: chunks. Biome colour table: data/<namespace>/simpleearth/biome_colors.json in any data pack (exact biome ids and tag rules, map colour names; Simple End's biomes and the c:
simpleearth.guide.page.14.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.14: convention tags ship with the mod), otherwise the map colour nearest the biome's grass colour. minGrid caps the finest grid the server serves (32 blocks), biomeVotes sets the biome majority per pixel.
simpleearth.guide.page.15.title: Terrain from the world generator
simpleearth.guide.page.15: With exploredOnly only areas with region files are shown.
simpleearth.guide.page.16.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.16: Behind every edge lies new terrain: four faces north is 4 edge lengths away, never back at the start (tesseract).
simpleearth.guide.page.17.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.17: V1 tile cube (shortest turn, flip at the corner), V2 cone fold (fourth tile squeezed in as a wedge),
simpleearth.guide.page.18.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.18: V3 corner window and tesseract inversion, V4 rolling cube (no jerk, side faces blend), V5 smooth ball (ground always level), V6 folding net
simpleearth.guide.page.19.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.19: (standard: the tile under you stays flat, neighbours fold in), V7 cell net (net of flat cube cells), V8 net with corner windows and inversion, V9 folding shell (all 25 tiles joined, nothing fades). V10-V12 stress the cube:
simpleearth.guide.page.20.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.20: V10 tipping cube (sharp, top always level, tips over an edge like a rolled die, edge lines), V11 puzzle cube (tips like V10,
simpleearth.guide.page.21.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.21: faces split into pieces with joints over a dark core), V12 corner view (tips like V10, higher up a corner turns towards
simpleearth.guide.page.22.title: Twelve versions
simpleearth.guide.page.22: you until three faces show like a block icon). Edges and corners are rounded in three steps like the UI frames.
simpleearth.guide.page.23.title: Sky
simpleearth.guide.page.23: In orbit the sky is black with stars, the sun stays a flat square far away, the moon is a small rounded cube lit by the sun whose position follows Vanilla's moon phase, and a stepped atmosphere rim glows blue on the day side,
simpleearth.guide.page.24.title: Sky
simpleearth.guide.page.24: indigo at night and orange at the light border. The earth fades in over the blend-in band above the switch height.
simpleearth.guide.page.25.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.25: Key O (or the Earth button top left in the pause menu in a development environment, devButton in simpleearth-client.json) opens a box at the right edge:
simpleearth.guide.page.26.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.26: the world stays visible, the movement keys keep working, the mouse works the menu. Pick V1 to V12 (two rows);
simpleearth.guide.page.27.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.27: the list first shows the display settings of all versions - detail level (1-5, standard 3 = twice as fine as before near you),
simpleearth.guide.page.28.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.28: detail range, render distance (tile rings), paint budget per frame, cached images and tiles, tile border, moon phases
simpleearth.guide.page.29.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.29: (E10), other players (E9) - then that version's own values (heights, edge length, orbit speed, sampling grid, orbit distance, shading, atmosphere, moon, stars and its own style values) as sliders - drag, click minus or plus, or Shift and the wheel.
simpleearth.guide.page.30.title: Menu
simpleearth.guide.page.30: Changes apply at once and are saved (display once, the rest per version; also /simpleclient simpleearth); the server clamps heights, edge and speed.
